title_cyr: Ела ми Величе на ново дуќанче
title_latin: Ela mi Veliče na novo duḱanče
title_en: Come to My New Little Shop, Velichka
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional playful dialogue song, origin unclear. 'Величе' is a name used as vocative (possibly a girl's name Velichka); 'мазник' (mazhnik) is my reading as a pastry (no certain translation).

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе на ново дуќанче.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče na novo duḱanče.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to my new little shop.

lines.cyr: - Идам, не идам, идам, не идам, сама ќе дојдам.
lines.lat: - Idam, ne idam, idam, ne idam, sama ḱe dojdam.
lines.en: - I'm coming, I'm not coming, I'm coming, I'm not coming, I'll come by myself.

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе гости да пречекаш.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče gosti da prečekaš.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to welcome the guests.

lines.cyr: - Не знам, не знам, не знам, не знам како се чека.
lines.lat: - Ne znam, ne znam, ne znam, ne znam kako se čeka.
lines.en: - I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know how guests are welcomed.

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе погача да месиш.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče pogača da mesiš.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to knead the flatbread.

lines.cyr: - Не знам, не знам, не знам, не знам како се меси.
lines.lat: - Ne znam, ne znam, ne znam, ne znam kako se mesi.
lines.en: - I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know how it is kneaded.

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе гуска да заколиш.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče guska da zakoliš.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to slaughter the goose.

lines.cyr: - Не знам, не знам, не знам, не знам како се коли.
lines.lat: - Ne znam, ne znam, ne znam, ne znam kako se koli.
lines.en: - I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know how it is slaughtered.

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе мазник да месиш.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče maznik da mesiš.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to knead the mazhnik pastry.

lines.cyr: - Не знам, не знам, не знам, не знам како се меси.
lines.lat: - Ne znam, ne znam, ne znam, ne znam kako se mesi.
lines.en: - I don't know, I don't know, I don't know, I don't know how it is kneaded.

lines.cyr: - Ела ми Величе ручек да ручаме.
lines.lat: - Ela mi Veliče ruček da ručame.
lines.en: - Come, Velichka, to have lunch together.

lines.cyr: - Идам, не идам, идам, не идам, еве кај идам,
lines.lat: - Idam, ne idam, idam, ne idam, eve kaj idam,
lines.en: - I'm coming, I'm not coming, I'm coming, I'm not coming, here I come,
